name: fractional_recovery_v1_sana_moving

arms.M: Full measured memory with original future targets
arms.F: Identical measured memory plus fractional translation recovery

policy.recovery: Request half the boundary residual this chunk; redistribute unserved recovery over remaining command frames; report any final shortfall
policy.speed: nominal budget = 2 * max original plan RGB step; incoming overspeed is slewed down
policy.acceleration: max(nominal speed budget, incoming speed) / native interval
policy.direction: No halfspace restriction; return toward overshot targets and intended turns allowed
policy.inverse_gain: disabled; fraction is not plant gain

scope: Two-seed, one-moving-scene, one-boundary implementation test. Not population efficacy, seed-variance estimation or oscillation validation. No fresh native A arm; existing A/M evidence is separately versioned.
controls: Exact prefix RGB and shared observation key
Past commands and future rotations unchanged

other_models.lingbot: Joint normalization and state-rebuild qualification remain separate; two seeds cannot resolve the reported seed variability or estimate efficacy.
other_models.dreamx: Future-only issuance routine requires one nominal feedback boundary, then lag-driven recovery; natural excitation is not guaranteed to identify authority. Native host qualification remains pending.

resources: Serial existing GPU locks; 4 GiB launch / 2 GiB runtime disk reserve, 2 GiB available host RAM, 5400-second timeout
